en: Vintage monochrome postcard with two photographs. The upper image shows a village street (Dorfstrasse) with traditional houses and a prominent church with a tall spire and clock tower in the center background. A person walks along the unpaved road, and wooden fences line the street. The lower image shows a large two‑storey school building (Schule) with many windows and a hipped roof, surrounded by a metal fence and small trees. The captions are printed in red German script.
